spec.notes: EXP-C: Domain extension. arXiv abstracts as seed instead of WikiText. Tests whether depth signal is domain-independent. After EXP-A/B.
spec.pipeline: arXiv seed → QLoRA finetune → generate (d0-d3, 500/depth) → feature extraction (Pythia-1.4B ref) → RF 5-fold CV

experiment_data.hypothesis: Domain extension: 用 arXiv abstracts 替代 WikiText 作为 seed，验证 depth signal 是否 domain-independent。成功标准：4-class acc ≥ 65%, top features 与 WikiText pipeline 一致。
